content.short: Blockhead lets you track, visualize, and explore crypto, DeFi, NFT, and web3 data in a single customizable interface.
content.description: Blockhead serves as a meta interface for EVM blockchains, DeFi apps, and broader web3 protocols. It brings together a crypto/DeFi/NFT portfolio tracker, a cross-EVM block explorer, and data explorers for DeFi projects and web3 networks. Designed as a data-agnostic progressive web app, Blockhead integrates a wide range of indexing solutions and infrastructure providers across the decentralized web, delivering a concise, transparent, and customizable experience.
